purpose: Reusable task blueprints inspired by public web-agent benchmarks, adapted to self-hosted software-testing SUTs. These are not copied benchmark task instances and require local reset/oracle admission.

templates.intent_pattern: Navigate from the authenticated start page to a named target and leave the target visibly open.
templates.oracle_plan: visible route/title plus independent target identity

templates.intent_pattern: Search for a fixed query, verify expected results, and verify a negative control is absent.
templates.oracle_plan: visible result set plus relational/API product identifiers

templates.intent_pattern: Fill multiple named fields, submit, revisit the object, and verify all fields persist.
Create an object on one page, navigate away, return through a list/search page, and verify identity and state.
Perform a role-scoped operation and verify both allowed state and denied alternative state.
templates.oracle_plan: database authorization state plus visible permission outcome

templates.intent_pattern: Submit a valid form under controlled delay and verify that retries do not duplicate or corrupt the object.
Select a visually identified control whose accessible name is stable or intentionally changed by condition.
templates.oracle_plan: visible postcondition plus independent state oracle

templates.intent_pattern: Replay a previously valid test after a declared UI evolution and repair only the test artifact.
templates.oracle_plan: same independent oracle and repeated replay
